VATA
Air & SpaceDry, Flaky & Sensitive Skin

Your skin craves deep nourishment. Vata skin tends to feel tight, rough, and dehydrated — especially in cold or dry weather. It needs warmth, moisture, and grounding care to restore its natural glow.

Key ingredients Ciamor uses
Ashwagandha · Saffron · Moringa · Aloe Vera
Your ritual is about
Hydration. Repair. Protection.

PITTA
Fire & WaterSensitive, Reactive & Acne-Prone Skin

Your skin runs hot. Pitta skin is prone to redness, breakouts, and inflammation — often triggered by heat, stress, or harsh products. It needs cooling, calming care that soothes without stripping.

Key ingredients Ciamor uses
Manjistha · Sandalwood · Aloe Vera · Green Tea
Your ritual is about
Cooling. Soothing. Balancing.

KAPHA
Water & EarthOily, Congested & Dull Skin
